description: Timeless Charm Meets Modern Luxury! Beautifully remodeled Craftsman-style gem in the coveted Wood Streets neighborhood, walking distance to Christmas Tree Lane! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home blends historic character with contemporary elegance. Featuring an updated kitchen with quartz countertops, black appliances, and custom cabinetry, along with updated bathrooms, fresh flooring, and upgraded AC/HVAC, this home is completely move-in ready. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed to enhance its historic charm while offering all the comforts of modern living. Located just minutes from downtown Riverside, you'll enjoy easy access to the Mission Inn, trendy restaurants, and vibrant entertainment. Don’t miss this rare opportunity to own a stunning home in one of Riverside’s most iconic neighborhoods!
